evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of an irregular pulse noted at a routine visit in a
patient with paroxysmalatrial fibrillation.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 74 bpm. Normal axiis. PR interval 198 ms, QRS 88 ms, QTc
416 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular sie. Left ventricular ejection frction estimated at 40%.
Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 172 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 93 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 50 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 148 mg/dL

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 137 mmol/L
Potassium: 5.0 mmol/L
Chloride: 102 mmol/L
CO2: 29 mmol/L
BUN: 14 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL
Glucose: 135 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.9 mg/dL

Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
